name: Alustra® Woven Textures®
description: Alustra® Woven Textures® offer an exclusive collection of richly woven fabrics with intricate patterns and refined colorways for Hunter Douglas window treatments.

benefits.text:
24
Benefits
Innovative Fabric Collection
A custom curated collection of globally sourced fabrics with sumptuous textures designed to filter light 
for the ultimate in style.
Three Product Styles
The fabrics in this collection are available as Roman Shades, Roller Shades and Skyline® Panels. Use 
together for a Whole House Solution or separately to finish any room with style and functionality.
25
Opacity & Light Control Options
Fabrics in this collection feature varying levels of opacity from sheer to semi-opaque. In addition, the 
Roller Duolite® Shade, Dual Roller and Roman Shade with Independent Operable Liner allow you to 
enhance light control and privacy with the sheerest of fabrics. 
PowerView® Automation
PowerView® Automation provides the ultimate in home automation allowing you to control every 
shade with the touch of a button.
